title: A JSON file under a `.novis/completion` folder offers values at the string parameters it names, changes only the string the cursor is in, and is read and never run
divergesFromPhp: PhpStorm's `.phpstorm.meta.php` is one PHP file it parses for the same purpose; a completion file is JSON, any number of them may sit in any `.novis/completion/` folder, and any program may write one
